ja.tagline: 開演中の劇場で起きた殺人。幕間の楽屋で見つかった被害者と、3人の容疑者。

en.tagline: A murder on opening night. The victim is found in a locked dressing room during intermission, and three people wanted him gone.

ja.tagline: AI研究所のサーバー室で、開発者が機械に押しつぶされて死んだ。容疑者は、4体のAI。

en.tagline: The AI pioneer is crushed in a sealed server room. The only suspects are four AIs.
